user_story: As a user, I want to be able to interact with alert and confirm dialogs on the Alerts page so that I can see how the application handles these interactions. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'alertButton', an alert dialog should appear. 2. When I click the button with id 'confirmButton', a confirm dialog should appear. 3. The URL should remain the same after interactions with the dialogs.
